title: LLM Evaluation Framework
summary: This module provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating LLM outputs and agent trajectories. It includes various evaluators for parsing, QA, criteria-based assessment, and pairwise comparisons, leveraging LLMs and external tools.

nodes.label: String Evaluation Interface
nodes.title: StringEvaluator Base Class
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental contract for evaluators that assess a single string prediction against optional input and reference labels.

nodes.label: Pairwise Evaluation Interface
nodes.title: PairwiseStringEvaluator Base Class
nodes.description: Establishes the contract for evaluators designed to compare two distinct string predictions, often from different models or prompts.

nodes.label: Agent Trajectory Evaluation Interface
nodes.title: AgentTrajectoryEvaluator Base Class
nodes.description: Specifies the interface for evaluators that analyze the sequence of actions and observations within an agent's execution path.

nodes.label: Validate JSON Format
nodes.title: JsonValidityEvaluator
nodes.description: Checks if a given text string adheres to valid JSON syntax, returning a score based on its structural correctness.

nodes.label: Compare JSON Content
nodes.title: JsonEqualityEvaluator
nodes.description: Determines if two JSON strings are semantically equivalent after parsing, useful for verifying structured data outputs.

nodes.label: Validate JSON Schema
nodes.title: JsonSchemaEvaluator
nodes.description: Verifies if a JSON prediction conforms to a predefined JSON schema, ensuring data structure and type compliance.

nodes.label: Evaluate QA Correctness
nodes.title: QAEvalChain
nodes.description: Assesses the accuracy of a model's generated answer to a question by comparing it against a ground truth reference.

nodes.label: Evaluate QA with CoT
nodes.title: CotQAEvalChain
nodes.description: Utilizes Chain-of-Thought reasoning to provide a more nuanced and explainable evaluation of Question Answering performance.

nodes.label: Evaluate by Criteria
nodes.title: LabeledCriteriaEvalChain
nodes.description: Judges model outputs based on a set of explicit criteria and a provided reference, yielding a pass/fail or graded result.

nodes.label: Compare Model Outputs
nodes.title: LabeledPairwiseStringEvalChain
nodes.description: Facilitates the comparison of two model responses using an LLM, often with labeled preferences or specific evaluation criteria.

nodes.label: Score Model Output
nodes.title: LabeledScoreStringEvalChain
nodes.description: Assigns a numerical score (e.g., 1-10) to a model's output based on predefined criteria and a reference answer.

nodes.label: Evaluate Agent Trajectory
nodes.title: TrajectoryEvalChain
nodes.description: Analyzes the step-by-step execution of an agent, including tool calls and intermediate thoughts, for overall effectiveness.

nodes.label: Load Evaluator Instances
nodes.title: load_evaluators
nodes.description: A utility function that simplifies the instantiation and configuration of various evaluation chains based on specified types.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: Provides the core AI capabilities for generating responses and performing reasoning tasks within LLM-based evaluators.

nodes.label: Prompt Templates
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Defines structured inputs and instructions for language models, guiding their behavior during evaluation tasks.

nodes.label: Agent Tools
nodes.title: BaseTool
nodes.description: Represents external functionalities or APIs that an agent can invoke, crucial for evaluating agent trajectories.

nodes.label: JSON Schema Library
nodes.title: jsonschema
nodes.description: An external Python library providing the necessary functionalities for validating JSON data against schemas.

groups.label: Evaluation Interfaces
groups.title: Core Evaluation Interfaces
groups.description: Abstract base classes defining the contracts for different types of evaluation, ensuring consistency across evaluators.

groups.label: Parsing Evaluators
groups.title: Structured Data Validation
groups.description: Evaluators focused on validating and comparing structured data formats like JSON, ensuring correctness and adherence to schemas.

groups.label: LLM-Powered Evaluators
groups.title: AI-Driven Performance Assessment
groups.description: Evaluators that leverage Language Models to perform complex assessments, including QA, criteria-based grading, and agent trajectory analysis.

groups.label: Evaluator Management
groups.title: Evaluator Instantiation Utility
groups.description: A utility component for simplifying the process of loading and configuring various evaluation chains based on their specified types.
